metaDescription: London Retaining Walls won our 2026 Retaining Wall Construction award for London, Ontario. See services, a client review and where they work.
summary: London Retaining Walls installs and repairs block, concrete and wood retaining walls for homeowners across London and Southwestern Ontario. With over 8 years of specialist experience, the company positions itself around Ontario Building Code compliance and thorough on-site consultation.

editorial.heading: What they do
editorial.text: London Retaining Walls installs concrete, block, and wood or timber retaining walls, and also handles retaining wall repair specifically, a service many general landscapers do not offer. Retaining wall repair matters because a leaning or failing wall is a common problem homeowners struggle to find help with.

editorial.heading: How they work
editorial.text: The company describes its work as fully compliant with the Ontario Building Code, relevant since retaining walls over roughly one metre typically require a permit and engineered design in most Ontario municipalities. It also says final payment is only requested after the client is satisfied with the result, a payment structure worth confirming in writing before work begins.

editorial.heading: What homeowners say
editorial.text: One review describes a leaning wood retaining wall that other landscape contractors declined to repair. This company took on the repair and rebuilt it in three days, according to the homeowner, who recommended the business specifically for stepping in where others would not.

editorial.heading: Where they work
editorial.text: The business serves London, Woodstock, Brantford, St. Thomas and the wider Southwestern Ontario region, for both residential and commercial retaining wall projects. Its multi-city footprint suggests it regularly travels beyond London itself.

What drainage and backfill approach do you use behind the wall to prevent future failure?

faq.q: What does the Service Excellence Award mean?
faq.a: London Retaining Walls was selected through our independent editorial review for 2026 as the top retaining wall contractor serving London, Ontario, based on public services, reviews and service area, with no fee for consideration or winning.

faq.q: Do they repair existing walls or only build new ones?
faq.a: Both. Retaining wall repair is a named service alongside new installation in concrete, block and timber.

faq.q: Does a retaining wall need a permit in Ontario?
faq.a: Generally, walls over about one metre in height require a permit and often an engineered design; requirements vary by municipality, so confirm with your local building department and the contractor.
London, Woodstock, Brantford, St. Thomas and the surrounding Southwestern Ontario area, for residential and commercial projects.
